1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width;
9:   const height = canvas.height;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const shipSize = 20;
13:   const shipSpeed = 4;
14:   const asteroidSize = 30;
15:   const asteroidSpeed = 2;
16:   const orbSize = 10;
17:   const totalOrbs = 5;
18:   const gameDuration = 30; // seconds
19: 
20:   let keys = {};
21:   let ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - shipSize * 2, radius: shipSize / 2 };
22:   let asteroids = [];
23:   let orbs = [];
24:   let startTime = null;
25:   let gameOver = false;
26:   let collected = 0;
27:   // sounds
28:   const collectSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
29:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
30:   const winSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
31:   let endSoundPlayed = false;
32: 
33:   // Input handling
34:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
35:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
36: 
37:   function spawnAsteroid() {
38:     const x = Math.random() * (width - asteroidSize) + asteroidSize / 2;
39:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -asteroidSize, radius: asteroidSize / 2 });
40:   }
41: 
42:   function spawnOrbs() {
43:     while (orbs.length < totalOrbs) {
44:       const x = Math.random() * (width - orbSize) + orbSize / 2;
45:       const y = Math.random() * (height - orbSize) + orbSize / 2;
46:       // avoid spawning on top of ship
47:       if (Math.hypot(x - ship.x, y - ship.y) > shipSize * 2) {
48:         orbs.push({ x, y, radius: orbSize / 2, collected: false });
49:       }
50:     }
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update() {
54:     // move ship
55:     if (keys.ArrowLeft && ship.x - shipSize > 0) ship.x -= shipSpeed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowRight && ship.x + shipSize < width) ship.x += shipSpeed;
57:     if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.y - shipSize > 0) ship.y -= shipSpeed;
58:     if (keys.ArrowDown && ship.y + shipSize < height) ship.y += shipSpeed;
59: 
60:     // update asteroids
61:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += asteroidSpeed);
62:     // remove off‑screen asteroids
63:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y - a.radius < height);
64: 
65:     // spawn new asteroids periodically
66:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
67: 
68:     // collisions
69:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70:       const a = asteroids[i];
71:       if (dist(a, ship) < a.radius + ship.radius) {
72:         gameOver = true;
73:         crashSound.play();
74:         break;
75:       }
76:     }
77: 
78:     // orb collection
79:     orbs.forEach(o => {
80:       if (!o.collected && dist(o, ship) < o.radius + ship.radius) {
81:         o.collected = true;
82:         collected++;
83:         collectSound.play();
84:       }
85:     });
86: 
87:     // win condition
88:     const elapsed = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
89:     if (collected === totalOrbs || elapsed >= gameDuration) {
90:       gameOver = true;
91:     }
92:   }
93: 
94:   function draw() {
95:     // background gradient (space)
96:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
97:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
98:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
99:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
100:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
101: 
102:     // ship (triangle pointing up)
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
104:     ctx.beginPath();
105:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.radius);
106:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
107:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
108:     ctx.closePath();
109:     ctx.fill();
110: 
111:     // asteroids
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f33';
113:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
114:       ctx.beginPath();
115:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
116:       ctx.fill();
117:     });
118: 
119:     // orbs
120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
121:     orbs.forEach(o => {
122:       if (!o.collected) {
123:         ctx.beginPath();
124:         ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
125:         ctx.fill();
126:       }
127:     });
128: 
129:     // UI text
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
131:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
132:     const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
133:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
134:     ctx.fillText(`Orbs: ${collected}/${totalOrbs}`, 10, 38);
135:   }
136: 
137:   function loop() {
138:     if (!gameOver) {
139:       update();
140:       draw();
141:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:     } else {
143:       // play ending sound once
144:       if (!endSoundPlayed) {
145:         if (collected === totalOrbs) {
146:           winSound.play();
147:         } else if (!crashSound.paused) {
148:           // crash sound already played on collision
149:         } else {
150:           // generic lose sound (reuse crash)
151:           crashSound.play();
152:         }
153:         endSoundPlayed = true;
154:       }
155:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
156:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
157:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
159:       const msg = collected === totalOrbs ? 'You Win!' : 'Game Over';
160:       ctx.fillText(msg, width / 2 - ctx.measureText(msg).width / 2, height / 2);
161:     }
162:   }
163: 
164:   function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
165: 
166:   // init
167:   spawnOrbs();
168:   startTime = Date.now();
169:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
170: })();

(End of file - total 170 lines)
</content>
